clusters.headline: Carbapenemase cluster in K. pneumoniae
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 47 genes, led by class A carbapenemase (KPC) (14) and extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (11). The species breakdown is dominated by Klebsiella pneumoniae (41), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 38 Resistant and 9 Susceptible across 96 deduplicated strains. The supporting rows span 14 countries and 2009 to 2024, so the observation is not limited to a single-country, single-year subset.

The supporting rows span 21 countries and 2006 to 2025, so the observation is not limited to a single-country, single-year subset.

The species breakdown is dominated by Enterococcus faecium (22), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 19 Resistant and 10 Susceptible across 71 deduplicated strains. The supporting rows span 11 countries and 2008 to 2024, so the observation is not limited to a single-country, single-year subset.

clusters.headline: MCR-1 cluster in E. coli
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 12 genes, led by phosphoethanolamine transferase MCR-1 (5) and IncI2 plasmid mobilization protein (3). The species breakdown is dominated by Escherichia coli (8), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 9 Resistant and 3 Susceptible across 6 deduplicated strains. Because the pattern is confined to a single country or collection year (2016), read it as a possible outbreak or sampling artefact.

clusters.headline: Toxin cluster in C. difficile
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 18 genes, led by toxin A (tcdA) (4) and toxin B (tcdB) (4). The species breakdown is dominated by Clostridioides difficile (18), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 7 Resistant and 11 Susceptible across 58 deduplicated strains. The supporting rows span 9 countries and 2011 to 2023, so the observation is not limited to a single-country, single-year subset.
